question: What will be the percentage change in the Russell 2000 index (^RUT on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-08-24 to the close on 2026-09-15?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-09-15 / close on 2026-08-24 - 1), using daily closes of ^RUT on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-09-15, the last close before it is used.
research:
## 1. Resolution source
- The Yahoo Finance ^RUT history page could not be fetched (the proxy refused the connection), so I could not check the value there directly.
- 2026-08-24: The Russell 2000 closed at **2,995.08**, down 0.76% on the day. This is the baseline for the question. It comes from secondary sites, Tapeboard and ChartDetectorAI, and the two agree. A Yahoo snapshot dated that day showed 2,999.56 (down 18.31), but it may have been taken before the close. [Tapeboard](https://tapeboard.com/blog/market-pulse-2026-08-24), [ChartDetectorAI](https://chartdetectorai.com/en/markets/russell-2000)
- Working back from the 0.76% drop, the 2026-08-21 close was about 3,018. That is my own arithmetic, not a reported figure.
- For reference, the index would need to close at about 3,295 for +10%, 2,845 for -5% and 2,696 for -10%.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The window runs 15 trading days (Labor Day on Sep 7 is a holiday), and no move has happened that comes close to deciding it.
- 2026-08-24: The index was about 2.4% below its record close.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-24: Markets were mixed and chip stocks led tech lower. The S&P 500 fell 0.28% to 7,652.86, the Nasdaq fell 0.76% to 25,980.19, and the Dow rose 0.26% to 53,417.16. [AP via InsuranceNewsNet](https://insurancenewsnet.com/oarticle/how-major-us-stock-indexes-fared-monday-8-24-2026), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/23/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)
- 2026-08-21: The Dow ended a down week (off 0.85%), and long-term Treasury yields weighed on tech stocks. [FXEmpire](https://fxempire.com/forecasts/article/the-week-ahead-nvidia-pce-and-jackson-hole-test-the-stock-market-rally-1618238)
- 2026-08-14: The Russell 2000 set its record close of 3,068.42, after 3,052.85 on Aug 13. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russell_2000_Index), [InvestingLive](https://investinglive.com/stocks/us-stocks-end-the-week-mixed-russell-2000-closes-at-a-record/)
- 2026-08-12: It posted its 27th record close of 2026 and was up about 22.7% year to date. [Regards of Wall Street](https://www.regardsofwallstreet.com/news/russell-2000-record-high-small-caps-beating-nasdaq-100)
- July 2026: The Fed held rates at 3.50-3.75% for a fifth straight meeting, but three officials dissented in favor of a hike. Core PCE was running at about 3.3-3.4%, so a September hike is a live risk, and that matters more for small caps because they are sensitive to rates. [Trading Economics](https://tradingeconomics.com/united-states/interest-rate/news/579138)
- 2026-06-22: The index closed above 3,000 for the first time. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russell_2000_Index)

## 4. Base rates
- I did not find a published base rate. The figures below are my own estimates from general knowledge of the index.
- The Russell 2000's realized volatility is usually about 18-25% a year. Over 15 trading days that gives a standard deviation of roughly 4.5-6%. An approximate 95% range is about -11% to +11%, and moves of -15% or worse have happened only in crisis periods such as 2020 and 2008.
- Over 15 trading days the median change is slightly positive, around +0.5%.
- Late August through mid-September has historically been one of the weaker stretches of the year for small caps.
- The index is close to a record after a strong year so far, about +20%. Momentum is positive, but the stock is priced richly.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi has a market asking how high the Russell 2000 will go in September 2026, with strikes at 2,950, 3,000, 3,050 and more. The search result showed no usable prices and no date. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxrut/russel-2000/kxrut-26sep30)
- Before Jackson Hole, futures implied roughly 35-38% odds of a Fed hike in September (about 65% for no change). [TMGM](https://www.tmgm.com/cht/analysis/market-insight/week-ahead-warsh-at-jackson-hole-nvidia-earnings-tokyo-inflation), [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/blog/en-july-2026-fed-rate-decision-kevin-warsh-expected-to-hold-as-hike-odds-remain-at-38)
- I found no Polymarket or Manifold market and no expert point forecast for this window.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-09-15
- Week of Aug 24-28: Nvidia earnings (revenue expected near $92B, EPS $2.09), plus Marvell, Salesforce and CrowdStrike. Also due are the preliminary Q2 GDP revision, durable goods orders and July PCE (forecast 3.6% headline, 3.3% core). [FXEmpire](https://fxempire.com/forecasts/article/the-week-ahead-nvidia-pce-and-jackson-hole-test-the-stock-market-rally-1618238), [CMC Markets](https://www.cmcmarkets.com/en-gb/news-and-analysis/the-week-ahead-us-pce-tokyo-cpi-nvidia-earnings)
- Late August: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh speaks at Jackson Hole. This is the key signal for whether the Fed hikes in September. [Saxo](https://www.home.saxo/en-gb/content/articles/equities/week-ahead-24--28-aug-21082026)
- About Sep 4: the August jobs report. Sep 7: Labor Day, markets closed.
- About Sep 10-11: August CPI and PPI. I have not confirmed these dates.
- Sep 15-16: the FOMC meeting. The decision comes on Sep 16, after the question resolves, but positioning ahead of it will show up in the Sep 15 close.
